nodes.label: #app root container
nodes.rationale: Empty mount point; entire UI is rendered client-side by script.js.

nodes.label: ADMIN_PASSWORD env variable
nodes.rationale: Always allows entry, acting as the access-recovery mechanism; must be long and random.

nodes.label: Botón Consultar (copy photo to clipboard + open chat)
nodes.norm_label: boton consultar (copy photo to clipboard + open chat)

nodes.label: Carrito (WhatsApp/Instagram inquiry cart)
nodes.rationale: Not a purchase: only builds an inquiry message with {lista}, {total}, {link}; {link} opens /#pedido=... page with photos.

nodes.label: data/data.json initial data
nodes.rationale: Used only until the first save; must not contain ph or salt.

nodes.label: Netlify Blobs storage
nodes.rationale: Data and uploaded photos are stored in Blobs so 'Guardar cambios' publishes instantly without pushing to GitHub; only code changes need a push.

nodes.label: Product photos (up to 6, resized to 1000px, viewer)
nodes.norm_label: product photos (up to 6, resized to 1000px, viewer)
nodes.rationale: Photos shrunk to 1000px before upload; unused photos are auto-deleted on save.

nodes.label: Admin security model (server-side verification, lockout, session expiry)
nodes.norm_label: admin security model (server-side verification, lockout, session expiry)
nodes.rationale: Password verified on server; 15-minute lockout after 5 failures; sessions expire at 4h, panel auto-closes after 30 min idle; password change revokes other sessions. Never commit ph/salt hashes or .env files.

nodes.label: placeholder.svg (product image fallback)
nodes.rationale: Default image shown for catalog products that have no photo; a flat 4:5 kraft-tan rectangle keeps card layout consistent without a real photo.
